borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions:
<div><span style="font-size:11pt">&nbsp;The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition,&nbsp;representing an overly dominant and excessive addition to the dwelling. The side extension would be significantly visible from public vantage points and would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and would be out of character in the context of the area. In particular, the proposal would not sit comfortably within the existing pattern of development.&nbsp; The accumulative impact of the two storey side extension, part single storey, part two storey rear extension and the front extension will result in the creation of a significantly staggered roof form and over development of the site.&nbsp; As such, the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design:</span></div><div><br></div><div><p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">-
